answers.xbro:
XBro went really well!! 
Chris was “window” but took over on chef when needed and worked really well! It allowed for me to focus on the flow we had going/where we needed help. 

I found that when we have a lot of mobile orders coming through to communicate with M3 and let them know to focus just on those. Especially if there’s newer people on bar it can help if they don’t have to worry about other orders at the same time and just focus on one thing!

I think things went really smooth today, overall great shift!
